title: Heavy Ball GMRESR method for Nonsymmetric Linear Systems
summary: The heavy ball GMRES (HBGMRES) method is one of Krylov subspace methods for linear systems combined with the restarted GMRES and the heavy ball method which is applied in optimization. HBGMRES not only keeps benefit of the restarted GMRES in limiting memory usage and controlling orthogonalization cost, but also is able to cover up the slow convergence problem in the restarted GMRES. Another type of Krylov subspace methods is GMRESR which consists of GCR as the outer algorithm and certain steps of GMRES as an inner method.
